newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine c.bank says new 18 pct rate starts July 8.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine c.bank says new 18 pct rate starts July 8.

text.p: The cut in Ukraine's key refinancing rate to 18 percent will be effective on July 8 and not on July 7, according to the bank's chief Viktor Yushchenko.

"As of tomorrow the refinancing rate will be 18 percent," Yushchenko told reporters after a news conference. The bank's press secretary said earlier the cut, from 21 percent, was effective from July 7.
The central bank last cut the rate on May 26 to 21 percent from 25 percent. Early last year the rate was 105 percent.
